item.title: Carnell Tate: No practice, not looking good
item.description:
Tate (shoulder) won't practice Friday, and his status for Sunday's game against the Bengals is in doubt, Paul Kuharsky reports.

item.description:

item.title: Jalen Coker: Salvages night with TD in loss
item.description:
Coker secured two of five targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. He also lost a fumble.

item.title: Jordan Love: Stays hot in Week 9 win
item.description:
Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.
